none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable objectives on real m×n matrices, permitting nonconvexity, with a global lower bound fmin and f(x0)−fmin≤Δ.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Jointly measurable, integrable, unbiased matrix-valued gradient samples g(x,ξ), with fresh IID seeds across individual oracle calls. Each sample counts as one call, including all samples within batches.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: There exists one fixed orthonormal row basis (b_i) and nonnegative σ_i with Σ_i σ_i≤s such that, uniformly in X, E‖(g(X,ξ)−∇f(X))ᵀb_i‖₂²≤σ_i². Neither independence between rows nor exponential tails is required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: non_euclidean_geometry
distinctive_assumptions.details: Spectral/nuclear dual geometry: ‖∇f(X)−∇f(Y)‖nuc≤L‖X−Y‖op. Allowed algorithms take constant-step polar directions of batch means.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/BatchedSpectralSmooth.lean: spec.admissible, spec.allowedAlgorithm and batchedIterate; LongTails/Setups/FiniteVarianceSpectralSmooth.lean: spectralNorm, nuclearNorm and polar.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m × Fin n), identified with real m×n matrices; m,n are natural numbers.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Public information consists of m,n,L,Δ,s,ε,x0, with L>0, Δ≥0, s≥0 and ε>0. The objective, sampling law, row basis and individual σ_i are hidden. Oracle seeds are IID and independent of the algorithm seed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/BatchedSpectralSmooth.lean: Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid and spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: The measurable output must have integrable nuclear gradient norm and satisfy E‖∇f(output)‖nuc≤ε; the norm is not squared.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Expectation is over algorithm and oracle randomness. The output is a uniformly selected iterate among x0,…,xT from the prescribed batched polar trajectory, after B(T+1) individual sample calls.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The formulation combines spectral-to-nuclear smoothness, a hidden fixed-basis row-variance profile, nuclear-norm expected stationarity and a prescribed batched polar algorithm family. Repository proofs and implementations were not inspected; the absence of a qualifying reference does not establish novelty.
